Research collaborations

Research collaboration allows different researchers to contribute complementary skills, knowledge, and perspectives to a project. Collaboration can involve research design, data construction, fieldwork, empirical analysis, and writing.

Working across projects has also provided opportunities to learn different approaches to empirical research. These experiences have strengthened my interest in development economics and applied research.
